## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Test plan

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm pack --dry-run`
- [ ] Manual DSH Web check (if UI/tool behavior changed)

## Compatibility

- [ ] Host-only change
- [ ] Client bundle change (refresh the Web GUI to test)
- [ ] Changes tool schema, output files, OYPX/GIF format, or DSH version range

## Checklist

- [ ] Added or updated tests
- [ ] No credentials, local absolute paths, or generated `pixel-art/` output
- [ ] Updated documentation/CHANGELOG where needed
